[![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/AlirezaParsi/COPG?style=for-the-badge&color=818cf8&label=version)](https://github.com/AlirezaParsi/COPG/releases) [![Zygisk](https://img.shields.io/badge/Zygisk-Compatible-34d399?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk) [![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-9.0%2B-3ddc84?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](https://www.android.com/) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/AlirezaParsi/COPG/total?style=for-the-badge&color=f59e0b)](https://github.com/AlirezaParsi/COPG/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/AlirezaParsi/COPG?style=for-the-badge&color=a78bfa)](LICENSE) **🌐 Official website — download COPG free & buy COPG PRO: [vendors.copg.my](https://vendors.copg.my)** 🌐 Languages / 语言：**English** · [简体中文](README.zh.md)
--- ## ✨ Why COPG? COPG is a **Zygisk module** that makes most games and apps believe they are running on a different, fully‑featured flagship device — unlocking the high‑FPS modes, HD graphics and premium tiers that are otherwise gated to specific hardware. It pairs that with a **CPU spoofer**, a userspace **comfort‑tweak controller**, and a beautiful on‑device **WebUI** to manage everything — all **without rebooting**. > 🎙️ **A COPG exclusive — concurrent microphone.** COPG is the **only Zygisk / Magisk / KernelSU module that lets two apps use the microphone at the same time** on Android — run a game's in-game voice chat *and* a screen recorder together, or keep recording while you're on a call. No other root module does simultaneous microphone access. See **[Concurrent Mic](#-features)** below. ## 🧰 Features > **Legend** — `FREE` no license · `PRO` license-unlocked · ⚠️ **risk-gated**: a resident (detectable) hook behind an in-app *use-at-your-own-risk* warning — **never for anti-cheat games**. Everything unmarked is **stealth** — the module unloads before the app runs, so nothing of COPG stays mapped in memory.
🎯 Device & Hardware - **Device Spoofing** `FREE` — per-app Build profile: brand, model, fingerprint, SDK, baseband, serial + 12 extra Build fields, so each app sees the exact flagship it rewards. - **Per-User Spoofing** — a different device per Android user / app-clone (HyperOS, One UI, work profiles); each clone gets its own derived Android ID / serial / advertising ID / IMEI. The app picker's **Apps for** drawer finds clones automatically. - **CPU Spoofing** `FREE` — report flagship-class silicon for apps that gate features on the chipset. - **GPU Spoofing** `PRO` ⚠️ — OpenGL renderer/vendor + Vulkan device name, per app. - **Refresh-Rate Spoof** `FREE` ⚠️ — a custom panel refresh rate (120 / 144 / 165 Hz) plus the full supported-modes list. - **Sensor Spoof** `PRO` ⚠️ — a per-app sensor-list fingerprint (name + vendor) so sensor-hashing anti-fraud SDKs see a consistent device.
🧬 Identity & Fingerprint - **Prop + Android ID** `PRO` — stealth copy-on-write prop spoof (fingerprint, build props) and per-app Android ID. *(CPU, device profiles, Build/serial and block-CPU stay `FREE`.)* - **IMEI / Device ID** `PRO` — fake IMEI per app, or **device-wide Global IMEI** (Settings, `*#06#` and every app — runs in a separate process, no risk gate). - **DRM / Widevine** `PRO` — report a higher Widevine security level (L1 / L2 / L3) and spoof the DRM device & system ID. - **Advertising ID** `PRO` — each app its own Google Advertising ID (auto per-app, or pin a UUID). - **App Set ID** `PRO` ⚠️ — each app its own Google App Set ID (auto per-app, or pin a UUID). - **Wallpaper ID** `PRO` — a per-app wallpaper ID, a data-clear-surviving link signal fraud SDKs read. *(stealth, system_server)* - **getprop Consistency** `PRO` ⚠️ — make an app's child `getprop` return the same spoofed values as the API, so the cross-check lines up (pair with the COW prop spoof). - **Google Account** `PRO` — a different Google-account list per app: hide all accounts, or one fake email per persona. *(stealth, system_server — beats DoorDash / Forter linking)*
📡 Network & Location - **SIM / Carrier** `PRO` — carrier name, operator code (MCC/MNC) & country, per app and per SIM slot; also per-app/slot IMSI & ICCID. **Safe** mode is stealth; **Aggressive** mode is resident ⚠️. - **Cell Tower** `PRO` ⚠️ — a fake serving cell: area code (LAC/TAC), cell ID (CID/CI/NCI) + optional MCC/MNC, consistent across `getAllCellInfo`. - **GPS Location** `PRO` ⚠️ — put an app anywhere (135 built-in places, or custom lat/lng); covers the normal location APIs and Google's Fused/GMS provider. - **Per-App Proxy** `PRO` — route one app through your own SOCKS5 / HTTP / SOCKS4 proxy (kernel-level, no interface the app can see, ban-safe). Pair with a matching SIM/region so device, SIM and IP agree. - **Timezone + Language** `FREE` — a per-app timezone and language/region (BCP-47); apps read and even render in the fake locale. *(stealth, system-side)*
🧩 App & System - **Play Source + PairIP Bypass** `PRO` — make an app look Play-installed and block Google's PairIP license check, so paid/locked apps open. *(stealth, out-of-app)* - **Tensor Feature Unlock** `PRO` — chosen apps see Google's Pixel **Tensor** system features (Tensor-gated AI). *(stealth, system_server)* - **WebView User-Agent** `PRO` — give any WebView app its own browser User-Agent, from a reusable named profile. - **WebView Canvas** `PRO` ⚠️ — per-app stable canvas-fingerprint noise (including iframes); breaks canvas tracking. *(WebGL is covered by GPU spoof.)* - **Fake Uptime** `PRO` — make an app think the device has run for days (Java + native readers), useful against anti-fraud / referral flows.
🔒 Privacy & Unlocks - **Privacy Hides** — **Hide VPN** (Java + native, pairip-safe) `FREE` · **Mock-Location hide** `PRO` · **Hide Developer Options + USB debugging** `FREE` — pass the checks banking / privacy apps run. - **Screenshot + Storage** `FREE` — disable **FLAG_SECURE** device-wide to capture apps that block it (banking, chat, wallets); **No Storage Restrict** re-enables picking Android/data, obb, the SD-card root and Download in the file picker. - **Install Patches** `FREE` — install modified / re-signed / downgraded APKs: disable signature verification, allow downgrade, skip the install verifier (Play Protect scan), allow compressed `resources.arsc`. *(system_server — this lowers a real security boundary; only install APKs you trust.)* - **Concurrent Mic** `FREE` 🏆 — **the only module that lets two apps use the microphone at the same time** (a game's voice chat + a screen recorder, or recording while on a call). Android normally silences one capturer; COPG stops that device-wide. *(out-of-process, audio server, no reboot)*
🎛️ Comfort Tweaks - **Per-App Comfort Tweaks** `FREE` — auto Do-Not-Disturb, disable auto-brightness, keep screen on, stop logging, and a per-app screen DPI — applied only while a tagged game is active, then restored.

⚙️ Advanced — edit profiles by hand
The WebUI is the recommended way to manage profiles, but you can also edit `/data/adb/modules/COPG/COPG.json` directly: ```json { "PACKAGES_REDMAGIC_9_PRO": [ "com.mobilelegends.mi", "com.supercell.brawlstars:with_cpu" ], "PACKAGES_REDMAGIC_9_PRO_DEVICE": { "BRAND": "ZTE", "MODEL": "NX769J", "FINGERPRINT": "ZTE/NX769J/..." } } ``` Package **tags** are colon suffixes — e.g. `:cpu=` (CPU spoof + pick the chip), `:gpu=` (GPU spoof + pick the GPU), `:cow` (prop spoof), `:aid` (Android ID), `:serial` (per‑app serial), `:gaid` (Advertising ID), `:appset` (App Set ID), `:drm` (Widevine), `:imei` (IMEI), `:sim=` / `:simx=` (SIM · safe / aggressive), `:tz=` (timezone), `:lang=` (language / region), `:ua=` (WebView User‑Agent), `:uptime=` (fake uptime), `:sensor` (sensor‑roster spoof), `:webfp` (WebView canvas spoof), `:tensorfeat` (Pixel Tensor features), `:gps=,` (GPS location), `:proxy` (per‑app proxy), `:mock` (mock‑location hide), `:vpn` / `:vpns` (VPN hide), `:hidedev` (hide developer options), `:blocked` (force real CPU), `:dnd` / `:dab` / `:kso` / `:nolog` / `:dpi=` (comfort tweaks).
--- ## ❓ FAQ
🤔 What does COPG stand for?
Originally CO (Call of Duty) + PG (PUBG) — the two games it was first built for. It now supports most games and apps, but the name is kept for its history.
📌 Will this get me banned?
COPG is designed to be undetectable, but safety can't be guaranteed. Use at your own risk.
⚡ Does it affect performance?
Minimal. The spoof runs only at app launch and doesn't touch in‑game performance.
🔧 How do I open the WebUI?
On KernelSU and APatch, open it straight from the manager. On Magisk, install the KSU WebUI app and open COPG from there.

  • 🆔 **Advertising ID** — view, randomize, set a custom one or restore your real ID (Settings · free)
  • 📡 **Global Hooks** — device‑wide **Global IMEI** (Settings): one fake IMEI for every app, `*#06#`

    • and the dialer

  • 💾 **Backup / Restore** & **Sync from GitHub**
  • 🎨 **Light / Dark / AMOLED** themes · 🌍 **10 languages** (EN, FA, AR, DE, ES, PT‑BR, ID, TH, TR, ZH)

    • ⚙️ Advanced — edit profiles by hand


    The WebUI is the recommended way to manage profiles, but you can also edit

    /data/adb/modules/COPG/COPG.json directly:

    {
  "PACKAGES_REDMAGIC_9_PRO": [
    "com.mobilelegends.mi",
    "com.supercell.brawlstars:with_cpu"
  ],
  "PACKAGES_REDMAGIC_9_PRO_DEVICE": {
    "BRAND": "ZTE",
    "MODEL": "NX769J",
    "FINGERPRINT": "ZTE/NX769J/..."
  }
}

    Package tags are colon suffixes — e.g. :cpu= (CPU spoof + pick the chip),

    :gpu= (GPU spoof + pick the GPU), :cow (prop spoof), :aid (Android ID),

    :serial (per‑app serial), :gaid (Advertising ID), :appset (App Set ID), :drm (Widevine),

    :imei (IMEI), :sim= / :simx= (SIM · safe / aggressive), :tz= (timezone),

    :lang= (language / region), :ua= (WebView User‑Agent), :uptime= (fake uptime),

    :sensor (sensor‑roster spoof), :webfp (WebView canvas spoof), :tensorfeat (Pixel Tensor features),

    :gps=, (GPS location), :proxy (per‑app proxy),

    :mock (mock‑location hide), :vpn / :vpns (VPN hide), :hidedev (hide developer options),

    :blocked (force real CPU), :dnd / :dab / :kso / :nolog / :dpi= (comfort tweaks).

    ❓ FAQ

    🤔 What does COPG stand for?


    Originally CO (Call of Duty) + PG (PUBG) — the two games it was first built for. It

    now supports most games and apps, but the name is kept for its history.

    📌 Will this get me banned?


    COPG is designed to be undetectable, but safety can't be guaranteed. Use at your own risk.

    ⚡ Does it affect performance?


    Minimal. The spoof runs only at app launch and doesn't touch in‑game performance.

    🔧 How do I open the WebUI?


    On KernelSU and APatch, open it straight from the manager. On Magisk, install

    the KSU WebUI app and open COPG from there.
